Evidence_in_Project: Divergent preprocessing, mirroring, and AU heuristics between training, eval, and WebSocket/REST degraded validation F1 (webcam_fix_log.md).
Mitigation: Unified all webcam routes and eval_clips.py on WebcamService.process_frame (Section 3.3, Section 5.1) and removed brittle AU rules (Section 5.2).

Risk: Domain Shift (Lab/TV Frames vs Live Webcam)
Evidence_in_Project: MELD-trained EfficientNet-B0 and static RAF-DB ResNet-18 degraded on speaking webcam video and confused surprise/disgust vs. anger/fear.
Mitigation: Mixed RAF-DB + aligned RAVDESS fine-tuning (Section 3.3.2) with MixedAugmenter occlusions/jitter raised cross-domain webcam accuracy (Section 5.1) while preserving resnet18_raf fallback.

Evidence_in_Project: Single-run timing under variable load showed p95 latency exceeding 100 ms, risking stalled 20 FPS WebSocket streams.
Mitigation: 320x180 JPEG85 stream canvas, WebSocket transport, in-flight isProcessing lock, and unified CPU benchmarking hold ~30 FPS within budget (Table 5.3).

Evidence_in_Project: Live camera & microphone stream sensitive biometric/speech data; debug capture could write frames if left enabled.
Mitigation: 100% volatile RAM processing (temporary uploads deleted on exit; opt-in debug capture; .gitignore dataset exclusions; explicit UI disclaimer; Section 4.6).

Evidence_in_Project: MELD skew (~47% neutral; <3% disgust/fear) collapsed unimodal audio recall, while conflicting TV frames caused overconfident fusion errors.
Mitigation: WeightedRandomSampler in StrongerAudioClassifier (Section 3.3.5), Transformer missing-modality masking, entropy reliability gates, and post-hoc Temperature Scaling (Section 3.3.7-3.3.8, Section 5.2).
